Hi Evelyn / Kimberly,

We're getting close to first invoice for the Q2 pilot. A couple quick questions so our AP team can accept the invoice without delays:

- Who will be the invoice emitter on your side? (email PDF from finance@ or system-generated from portal)
- Do you provide signed invoices or is a system-origin stamp sufficient?
- For EU VAT handling: can you include VAT reverse-charge indicator on the invoice and provide VAT IDs on the header?

We prefer receiving invoices via SFTP or via your billing portal. If you must email, please copy ap@pinestreet.com. I attached a sample PO so you can see their matching requirements.

Thanks,
Laura

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick response and proposed approach from Redwood: 

Summary proposal:
- Primary channel: Redwood Billing Portal (preferred) — portal will emit the canonical invoice (PDF + machine-readable UBL/UBL-XML) and store audit trail.
- Pilot fallback: For the first 3 invoices we'll send an email copy to ap@pinestreet.com in addition to portal delivery so your team has a short runway. After that we'll switch to portal-only unless you ask otherwise.
- Signatory: Redwood's invoices will be system-issued and bear the finance stamp "Redwood Inference Finance"; we do not typically hand-sign PDFs for production invoices. If PineStreet requires a wet signature for compliance, tell us and we'll route to legal.
- VAT / reverse charge: We can populate VAT IDs in header and set the reverse-charge flag. We need PineStreet's VAT ID (and whether they mandate a particular field mapping).

Connor — can you confirm the portal will include the following in the machine-readable payload: VAT ID (seller & buyer), taxCategory / taxScheme entries for reverse-charge, and that we can attach the PO reference for three-way matching? Also please confirm cutoff for same-day emission (we currently have 6pm UTC).

Action items for PineStreet: please confirm AP email we'll copy (ap@pinestreet.com OK?), confirm buyer VAT ID, and whether a signed PDF is required.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@pinestreet.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Mar 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice origin and VAT tagging for PineStreet pilot

Eve / Team — technical confirmation below.

- Portal payload: yes, the portal emits UBL 2.1 XML and includes structured elements for party identification (BuyerCustomerParty / SellerSupplierParty). We populate VAT / tax ID into PartyIdentification > ID and duplicate into TaxScheme where needed.
- Reverse-charge mapping: we set TaxCategory > Percent = 0 and TaxCategory > TaxExemptionReasonCode = "ReverseCharge" per EU buyer preference. We can also add a custom element <cbc:PaymentMeans> note if PineStreet needs a specific text string for their AP system.
- PO matching: we include <cac:OrderReference><cbc:ID> which maps to the PO number; portal supports three-way matching metadata.
- Cutoff: same-day emission if invoice created before 18:00 UTC (we can configure earlier cutoffs per account). For the pilot I'd recommend 17:00 UTC so there's time for the portal to push webhooks and email copies.
- Attachments: attached is a sample_einvoice_ubl.xml showing the fields (stub). If PineStreet's AP wants a different XML schema (Peppol BIS), we can supply that too.

Connor O'Brien
Engineering Manager, Billing Systems
Redwood Inference

Laura — thank you, this all looks good on our side. Confirming Redwood stance and next steps: 

- Channel: Portal will be canonical emitter. We'll include email copies to ap@pinestreet.com for the first three invoice cycles (March, April, May) to help your team validate matching. After May we'll turn off email copies unless you request extension.
- Signatory: system-issued with finance stamp only — if PineStreet requires a wet signature for their internal audit we need a formal request and we'll escalate to Legal (this is an exception and has a small processing fee).
- VAT info: please send buyer VAT ID and confirm whether you expect a reverse-charge code in TaxExemptionReasonCode or as a separate note. We'll default to TaxExemptionReasonCode="ReverseCharge" and include buyer VAT in the header.
- Cutoff / SLAs: invoices created before 17:00 UTC will be emitted same-day. For any PO-mismatch we'll send a webhook to your AP integration and copy ap@pinestreet.com.

Next steps (action owners):
- PineStreet: confirm ap@ address and provide Buyer VAT ID (Laura)
- Redwood Billing (Connor): prepare first two invoices with portal + email copy and share sample UBL delivered to ap@pinestreet.com by 2028-03-15
- Redwood Finance (Evelyn): confirm signatory wording and any DocuSign need if PineStreet insists on hand-signed PDFs

Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Onboarding 
Redwood Inference
